scope: Opt-in reproducible installed Chrome/Edge synthetic transport gate; not a reader workaround, model run, live research service or G3 acceptance
transport: Node HTTP/1 loopback, no-store, no credentials, redirects or external service; Vite serves the unchanged real ResearchSessionApi module in a fresh context per installed browser
observations: For every unique request retain application result, Playwright original terminal, CDP original terminal and server writes/finish/close. Collect terminals before teardown; missing, duplicated or inconsistent observations cannot pass
prefix_controls: prefix-over/timeout/abort send a 512-byte prefix; remainder is gated on the browser observing that first read. Prefix-over then exceeds the cumulative budget; timeout and abort never send the remainder
gate: Every positive must have exact bytes/hash and both raw completion events; every negative must reject for its intended reason. Payload correctness never excuses an original request failure
freeze: Fresh plan before run pins fixture, protocol, harness, matrix/tests, current frontend modules/config/dependency metadata, Node and browser executables; save source snapshots and check all pins again after cleanup
boundary: Application retained/published byte budget only; no claim of browser RSS/internal-buffer bounds. No native arrayBuffer/clone/tee replacement, system update, browser flag workaround or real assets
